indexentry.indexdefn: Monster sizes range from Minute, Tiny, Small, Medium, Large, Huge and Gargantuan. Humans are Medium, Cats are Tiny, and Elephants are Huge.

abilitydescription.p: Monsters come in varying sizes. Humans, Dwarves and Elves are considered medium, Halflings are small. Cats, Chickens are Tiny. Horses are Large. Elephants are Huge and Dragons are Gigantic.
This keyword describes the physical size of the creature.
